<div class="card-body">
'''Rycar Ryjerd''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ライカー・ライジャード</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">密輸屋ではないキャラクターに配備して、密輸屋の技能を与える。または、密輸屋に配備すると、戦闘力に＋１（「意識操作」のカードの影響を受けない）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-63o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ビムの商人で宇宙船用兵器の密輸屋。誰も信用しないくせに、誰とでも取引する。密輸の技術を教えている。ジャワ語に熟達している。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rycar Ryjerd.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on a character who is not a smuggler to give that character the smuggler skill. Or deploy on a smuggler to add 1 to power. Immune to Alter.

'''Lore:''' A Bimm merchant and smuggler of starship weapons. Trusts no one but will trade with anyone. Teaches smuggling techniques and is fluent in Jawaese.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Rycar Ryjerd]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
